rows.answer: The amber led means the system is in a fault state. The specific fault is Brown-out reset (E2) during Wi-Fi TX on power-stealing installs. To fix it, update the firmware to version 3.2.0 or later.

rows.answer: Yes, there was a firmware fix for it. The issue is listed as FW-1822: Brown-out reset during Wi-Fi TX on power-stealing installs (E2). The affected version range is 3.0.0 - 3.1.4.

rows.answer: 1. Confirm whether all devices or only one device is affected. 2. Check the INTERNET LED. If off, reseat the WAN cable at both ends. 3. If still unresolved, collect WAN logs (Admin Console > Diagnostics > Export) and escalate.
